h1: An AI company for Dubai businesses, with one accountable lead
intro: 22 Signals is a business solutions company that builds AI tools, cloud and data systems, websites and apps for Dubai companies, then grows them with search, paid media and video. One accountable lead runs the work, plans arrive in writing within 5 to 7 days, and we come on-site when the project needs it.

sections.h: Searching for an AI company in Dubai? Here is the honest version
p: The honest version is short. One lead owns your project from the first call to the final report. Specialist teams do the work, and every date is agreed in writing. We tell you early which parts need us on-site and which run well over video and shared documents.

What you get is one team that covers AI, cloud and data, the website or app those systems sit behind, and the marketing and video that bring customers to them. Many Dubai companies juggle three or four suppliers to get that, and projects stall in the gaps between them.
If you need AI that works inside a Dubai business, with WhatsApp-first customers, bilingual audiences and UAE data rules, read on.

sections.h: What Dubai companies hire us for
p: People who search for an AI company in Dubai usually need more than AI. This is what we cover:
list: AI consultancy: a ranked list of where AI pays off in your business, and a plan to do it under UAE and DIFC data rules.
AI automation: WhatsApp enquiries answered and routed, bookings made, reports written, with a person taking over when it matters.
Business intelligence and data analytics: one set of numbers across branches, malls, projects or warehouses.
Cloud consulting: AWS and Azure set up in UAE regions when data residency matters, with cost and security reviews.
Web development: English and Arabic sites with right-to-left support, built to rank and to convert on mobile.
App development: iOS, Android and web apps, including UAE PASS sign-in and local payment options where needed.
SEO and generative engine optimisation (GEO): showing up in Google and in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Google AI Overview answers for Dubai searches.
Paid media: Google, Meta, LinkedIn and TikTok campaigns tied to real leads, not clicks.
Video, animation and AI video: launch films, explainers and reels made for Dubai audiences.
3D rendering: photoreal visuals for off-plan property, interiors, products and packaging.

sections.h: The Dubai sectors we know best
p: Real estate and property development come first. Developers and brokerages need renders before anything is built, lead handling that copes with portal enquiries arriving at midnight, and ads that carry the Dubai Land Department permit details the rules ask for.
Hospitality and tourism follow closely. Hotels, restaurant groups and attractions live on reviews, WhatsApp bookings and seasonal peaks around the Dubai Shopping Festival and the cooler months.

We also work with retail and e-commerce brands selling across the Gulf, logistics and trading companies operating out of Jebel Ali, fintech and financial firms in the DIFC, and healthcare and aesthetics clinics working within Dubai Health Authority advertising standards.

The questions change with the district. A wealth manager in the DIFC usually asks about the DIFC Data Protection Law before anything else. A software company in Dubai Internet City wants product features and a launch plan. A family-owned trading house in Business Bay wants its reporting out of spreadsheets. A commodities firm licensed by DMCC in Jumeirah Lakes Towers wants document handling that does not break when a shipment is delayed.

Onshore Dubai businesses fall under the UAE Personal Data Protection Law, Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021. Firms in the DIFC follow the DIFC Data Protection Law, a separate regime with its own regulator. Health data carries extra storage rules at federal level. These rules decide which cloud region a system runs in, what a chatbot may remember and who sees a dashboard.

Both AWS and Microsoft Azure run cloud regions inside the UAE, so keeping data in the country is usually possible. We confirm what your sector, your licence and your own customers expect before anything is built. We are not your lawyers, and we will tell you when a question needs one.

sections.h: WhatsApp, Arabic and the way Dubai customers buy
p: In Dubai the first message is usually a WhatsApp message, not a form. Many customers search in English, others in Arabic, and a large share are residents from somewhere else entirely.

So we start from the channel your customers already use. We connect WhatsApp to your CRM, build English and Arabic sites with right-to-left support where your audience needs both, and plan content for the questions people in Dubai actually ask.

sections.h: How working with us from Dubai runs
p: Every engagement has one accountable lead, the Signal Lead, with specialist teams behind them. We follow four steps: Talk, Plan, Build, Grow. Every date we agree goes in writing.

Most UAE businesses now work Monday to Friday, and review calls are booked at times that suit your team. Each review starts from a written update, so the time goes on decisions rather than status reports. When a workshop, a shoot or a launch genuinely needs us in the room, we plan a visit as part of the scope.

We have delivered more than 30 AI builds for businesses that used to run the old way: custom tools, systems and automations that replaced manual work. We do not publish client names, but we will walk you through relevant examples on a call. It is the first thing to ask any AI company in Dubai or elsewhere: show me what you have built.

sections.h: Why Dubai companies pick one team over five suppliers
p: A good AI company in Dubai or anywhere else should tell you this plainly: the AI assistant, the website it lives on, the ads that send people there and the renders in those ads all have to agree with each other. When one team owns all of it, nobody blames the other agency: you get one person, one plan and one set of results.

faqs.q: What does a first project with you usually cover?
faqs.a: Most Dubai clients start with one clear problem: a website that does not bring enquiries, a manual process that eats staff time, or reporting nobody trusts. We run discovery, then send a written roadmap within 5 to 7 days with scope, owners and dates. The first build follows from that, and we report on what changed once it is live.

faqs.q: Is 22 Signals an AI company or a marketing agency?
faqs.a: Both, deliberately. We build AI tools, automations, cloud and data systems, websites and apps, and we also run SEO, paid media, video, animation and 3D. Most Dubai firms need several of these at once, and having one accountable lead for all of them is the main reason clients choose us over specialist shops.

faqs.q: Can you work with DIFC firms under the DIFC Data Protection Law?
faqs.a: Yes. We design systems for DIFC firms around the DIFC Data Protection Law, and for onshore companies around the UAE PDPL. In practice that means agreeing where data is stored, what an AI tool may keep, who has access and how requests are handled, before we build. Your legal adviser signs off the legal position.

faqs.q: Which Dubai industries do you work with?
faqs.a: Mainly real estate, hospitality and tourism, retail and e-commerce, logistics and trade around Jebel Ali, fintech in the DIFC, and healthcare and aesthetics clinics, plus technology and professional services firms. Each sector gets examples and rules specific to it, not a generic package.

We build English and Arabic sites with right-to-left support, and AI tools that handle messages in both languages. We do not claim in-house Arabic copywriters, so Arabic copy is either supplied by you or prepared by a translator you approve. We make sure layouts, forms and search setup work properly in both languages.

faqs.q: How much does it cost to work with you?
faqs.a: It depends on scope. The main factors are how many services you need, how many systems we connect, whether data must stay in a UAE cloud region, how many languages are involved and how fast you need it. We give a written scope and price after a short call, and every date goes in writing.
